contract.request_semantics: Exact base pair; ordered semantic/doc.patch commands; labelled steps with per-step patches; fields|atomic merge; declared reads; omitted doc.patch reads conservatively become atomic; exact-key idempotency.
contract.error_shape: Structured code/path/hint/suggested_command with actual head for conflicts; invalid is distinct from later-head conflict.
contract.preview: Same authorization/base/read/guard validation, status preview with would_status and null receipt, no store/history/idempotency/head mutation.
contract.undo_history: Whole/per-step guarded inverse with later-history/A->B->A scan; merged inverse uses actual landing head; labels, steps, reads, dependencies and attribution persist in history.
